import random
import string

def generate_test_case():
    s_length = random.randint(1, 20)
    s = ''.join(random.choice(string.ascii_lowercase) for _ in range(s_length))

    wordDict_length = random.randint(1, 1000)
    wordDict = []
    for _ in range(wordDict_length):
        word_length = random.randint(1, 10)
        word = ''.join(random.choice(string.ascii_lowercase) for _ in range(word_length))
        wordDict.append(word)

    return s, list(set(wordDict))
